description: Multi-agent LLM pipeline benchmark. Three independent GPT-2-style agent models communicate sequentially: Agent A generates from a prompt, Agent B processes A's output, Agent C combines outputs from A and B. Measures end-to-end latency and tokens/sec for multi-agent coordination.

scaling_param.name: tokens_per_agent
scaling_param.description: Number of tokens each agent generates (total = 3 x tokens_per_agent)

non_scaling_params.name: prompt_len
non_scaling_params.description: Length of the initial prompt in tokens

non_scaling_params.name: num_layers
non_scaling_params.description: Number of transformer blocks per agent model

non_scaling_params.name: hidden_size
non_scaling_params.description: Hidden dimension of each agent model

non_scaling_params.name: num_heads
non_scaling_params.description: Number of attention heads per agent model
